mapper.sql: id, owner_member_id, business_type, client_draft_key, subject_id, payload_json, payload_hash, status, version, updated_by_device, published_resource_id, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into content_draft (owner_member_id, business_type, client_draft_key, subject_id, payload_json, payload_hash, status, version, updated_by_device, create_time, update_time) values (#{ownerMemberId}, #{businessType}, #{clientDraftKey}, #{subjectId}, #{payloadJson}, #{payloadHash}, 'DRAFT', 1, #{updatedByDevice}, now(3), now(3))
mapper.select: select from content_draft where id = #{id} and owner_member_id = #{ownerMemberId}
select from content_draft where owner_member_id = #{ownerMemberId} and status = 'DRAFT' and business_type = #{businessType} order by update_time desc, id desc

select case when #{businessType} = 'ACTIVITY' then ( select count(*) from cms_activity where id = #{resourceId} and member_id = #{ownerMemberId} and del_flag = 0 ) when #{businessType} = 'TOPIC' then ( select count(*) from cms_topic where id = #{resourceId} and member_id = #{ownerMemberId} and del_flag = 0 and coalesce(is_draft, 0) = 0 ) else 0 end
